* Based on number of Fire/Bow/Lance allies in frontline, deploy Raging fire Stance or Piercing Flash Stance
* After, fire type piercing attack on all enemies (XXL)
** END, SPR -50% on all enemies (5 turns) and Pain on all enemies (Permanent, Ignore Target Resistance)
When used in Stellar Burst:
* Based on number of Fire/Bow/Lance allies in frontline, deploy Raging fire Stance or Piercing Flash Stance and awaken Another Zone (3 turns-) (many times per battle)
* After, fire type piercing attack on all enemies x9 (XXL, multiplier 30x)
** END, SPR -50% on all enemies (5 turns) and Pain on all enemies (Permanent, Ignore Target Resistance)
* Applies the following effects to user:
** Delayed Strike and Eagle Eyes (5 turns)
*** Will not override Preemptive moves
** Stack 5 Fortune
